replay.intro: Replays this run's tool loop in a sandbox: frozen inputs, the model's recorded decisions instead of a provider, every tool stubbed to its recorded result, a new run id, and a read-only database transaction. Nothing the learner sees changes; only a replay receipt is recorded.
replay.summary: Replay run <mono>{id}</mono> · tools stubbed · progress writes denied · {providerCalls} provider calls
replay.summaryReason: Replay run <mono>{id}</mono> · tools stubbed · progress writes denied · {providerCalls} provider calls · <mono>{reason}</mono>
replay.steps.caption: Replayed steps against recorded receipts
payload.withheld: Run payloads are withheld. Revealing one needs the run.payload permission, which owners and admins hold.
payload.receipt: Receipt <mono>{id}</mono> is on the learner's record and in the audit log.
payload.inert: Displayed as inert text. Nothing is executed. Text fingerprints are valid only within this reveal.
payload.intro: The run's inputs, tool arguments and results and its stored output are withheld by default. Revealing shows their structure, identifiers and states, and records a receipt that the learner and the audit log show. Model-written text is shown only as its length; the companion conversation, the learner model and teaching-hypothesis tool calls stay withheld.
retry.intro: Runs this {role} run again as a new run. The new run goes through the normal path: supervision control, the learner's consent, policy and budgets, then verification before anything reaches the learner. This run and its receipts stay as they are.
retry.retryOf: This run is a retry of run <mono>{id}</mono>.
retry.waiting: Waiting for the dispatcher to start the new run.
retry.forbidden: Retrying needs the run.retry permission (owners and admins).
retry.notRetryable: Only a run that failed, ended with an uncertain provider call, or was stopped by staff can be retried.
retry.reasonHint: Required, at least 10 characters. Kept in the staff audit record.
policies.estimates: Every amount here is an estimate from the operator's price list, not a provider invoice. Compare with billed amounts on the Integrations page.
cancel.intro: Stops this one run before it changes anything for the learner. The learner's AI supervision and their other runs carry on. A run you stop can be retried later.
cancel.receipt: Recorded as staff event <mono>{id}</mono>. The run stops at its next step, before any further provider call.
cancel.already: A stop was already requested for this run. It ends at its next step.
cancel.forbidden: Stopping a run needs AI supervision control (owners, admins and instructors).
cancel.ended: This run has already ended, so there is nothing to stop.
cancel.reasonHint: Required, at least 10 characters. Kept in the staff record, not shown to the learner.
policies.providerSource.host_file: The server's provider file (this workspace had no AI services setup of its own)
strategies.title: Which AI setup answered
strategies.none: No call of this run recorded which AI setup answered. Runs from before this was recorded show nothing here.
strategies.unchecked: At least one call ran with a setup that had no passing quality check and no owner approval at that time. It still ran; check or approve it on the AI services page.
